title: Newcomer Snapshot Journey — annotated quickstart image pack
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design package of annotated screenshots and marketing-ready image variants that demonstrate the quickstart/onboarding flow for new users. Purpose: supply product, docs, and comms teams with a cohesive visual toolkit for the next blog changelog and help center quickstart. Includes before/after UI comparisons, progressive-disclosure overlays, and microcallout annotations that map to copy in the release notes.
recent_updates: 2025-03-12: Initial exploration comps uploaded to Figma; two layout directions created (stepper-focused and dashboard-focused).
2025-03-14: PM review — preferred dashboard-focused direction for release hero; requested stronger CTA emphasis in 1200x628 social variant.
2025-03-16: Accessibility audit: removed low-contrast gradient on screenshot overlays; increased annotation font weight and ensured 4.5:1 contrast on callouts.
2025-03-18: Eng feedback: replaced a live-UI gif with a stepped before/after toggle to avoid capturing dynamic secrets; documented fallback images for localized strings.
2025-03-20: Final artboards exported for hero and social sizes; awaiting final signoff from Design Lead and PM.
export_specs: Primary raster exports: PNG, sRGB, flattened; hero at 1920x1080 and 1440x900
Mobile preview: 390x844 and 360x780 for device crops
Design tokens: annotation color, icon sizes, spacing scale included in README
design_notes: Use a 3-level annotation system: primary (feature callout), secondary (microcopy hint), tertiary (keyboard shortcut or link).
Prefer inline arrows and soft drop shadows instead of heavy gradient overlays to keep screenshots legible over varying backgrounds.
Include 'before' state showing legacy onboarding CTA and 'after' state with updated quickstart flow; highlight reduced clicks and clearer CTAs.
Dark mode comps included for all hero/social variants; ensure iconography adapts to background luminance.
Avoid capturing user-identifiable data — use dummy org and email placeholders.
review_feedback: PM (Priya): Tighten copy on primary callout to a single action verb; suggested 'Start in 30s' microcopy.
Engineering (Samir): Request for a non-animated before/after for docs due to CDN latency; prefer toggle image over GIF.
Accessibility (Elena): Increase annotation contrast, add focus-ring demo for keyboard users in mobile comp, provide alt text snippets in README.
Design Lead (Marta): Ok to simplify heavy illustrations; keep decorative pattern subtle and consistent across assets.
acceptance_criteria: All hero and social image variants exported and readable at target resolutions
Annotation copy reviewed and approved by PM
Accessibility checks passed (contrast, alt text snippets in README)
Assets uploaded to Drive + Figma share link provided to comms
One-line asset usage notes in docs draft and example alt text included
